I replied to Pree in a thread on their message in #central-team. I couldn't confirm the 16 August deadline.

- **No record of it:** I found no Tamsin Cold Chain files in the shared folders. #central-team, where Pree posted, has no earlier mention of a Tamsin order-form deadline. I didn't look in any other channels.
- **The date has passed:** Today on the simulation clock is 19 Oct 2026. So either they meant August next year or someone misheard.

I suggested Pree check the date with the Tamsin contact or the account owner before anyone plans around it.
